apps.short: An Islamic digital platform bringing together the Quran, Hadith, prayer times and mosque services.
apps.description:
StepTuDeen is a free, open source Islamic web app. It aims to make the Quran, Hadith and everyday religious needs available in one place. The app is currently in its experimental stage.

Holy Quran: full recitation, translations in Urdu and other languages, Tafsir Ibn Kathir, offline reading, last-read ayah saving and search.

Hadith Books: Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, Jami at-Tirmidhi, Sunan Abi Dawud, Sunan Ibn Majah, Sunan an-Nasai, Riyad as-Salihin, Muwatta Imam Malik and Al-Adab al-Mufrad, with grading labels.

Prayer Times: five daily prayers, countdown to the next prayer, nearby mosques, Friday times and Adhan/Iqamah notifications. Imam Dashboard for mosque registration and timing settings.

Other features: Qibla direction, duas and adhkar, digital tasbih, and saved favourite surahs and Hadith bookmarks.

apps.short: Profit Tracker is a simple and free web app that helps you record weekly income and expenses, calculate your net profit or loss, view financial charts, and save personal notes. All records are stored locally in your browser and organized by date and month.
apps.description:
Profit Tracker is a lightweight personal finance and productivity web app developed by StepTuDeen. It helps users keep track of their weekly earnings, expenses, and overall profit or loss in one convenient place.

Simply enter how much you earn and spend each day. The app automatically calculates your total income, total expenses, and net profit or loss as you update your records throughout the week. This makes it easier to understand your financial activity without performing manual calculations.

The app also includes weekly charts that provide a visual overview of your earnings, spending, and financial performance. These charts help you compare income and expenses and understand how your money is being managed over time.

A built-in notebook allows you to write and save important notes, reminders, and other information alongside your daily financial activities.

Your records are organized by month and date, making it easier to review previous entries and keep your financial history organized. The app uses your browser's local storage to save your data directly on your device, so an online account or remote database is not required for local record keeping.

Profit Tracker is designed for freelancers, small business owners, online earners, shopkeepers, students, and anyone who wants a simple way to monitor personal earnings and expenses.

Key Benefits:
- Track daily income and expenses throughout the week.
- Automatically calculate total earnings, expenses, and net profit or loss.
- View weekly financial summaries and charts.
- Write and save notes in the built-in notebook.
- Keep records organized by month and date.
- Store data locally in your browser.
- Use the app on compatible mobile phones, tablets, and desktop devices.
- Manage your basic financial records with a simple and free web app.

Privacy Note: Financial records are stored locally in the browser. Clearing browser data, uninstalling an associated web app, or changing devices may affect access to saved records. Use an appropriate backup method if you need to preserve your data.

Profit Tracker is a practical tool for everyday financial record keeping. It is intended for tracking purposes and does not provide professional accounting, tax, or investment advice.

apps.short: The Mill Game is a feature-rich Nine Men's Morris strategy game by StepTuDeen. Play against the computer, challenge a friend offline, or compete online with real-time voice chat, text messaging, emoji reactions, and spectator mode. Install it as a Progressive Web App on supported devices.
apps.description:
The Mill Game is a modern web-based version of the classic Nine Men's Morris board game, developed by StepTuDeen. It combines traditional strategy gameplay with offline modes, online multiplayer, real-time communication, and Progressive Web App support.

GAME MODES
Choose between playing against the computer, playing with a friend on the same device, or competing against another player online. Offline game modes are designed to work without an internet connection, subject to the game's available local functionality.

ONLINE MULTIPLAYER
Challenge another player in real-time online matches. Players can communicate using WebRTC-based voice chat, exchange text messages, and react with emojis during gameplay. Online features require an internet connection and the relevant service configuration.

SPECTATOR MODE
Up to two spectators can join an online match and watch the game in progress. Supported voice and text communication features allow spectators to interact with participants, while spectators remain unable to move pieces or interfere with the board.

CLASSIC NINE MEN'S MORRIS STRATEGY
Place and move pieces strategically to form mills by aligning three pieces. Forming a mill allows a player to remove an eligible opponent piece according to the game rules. Block the opponent's possible moves and plan each move carefully to secure victory.

PROGRESSIVE WEB APP
The game supports installation through compatible browsers and includes a web app manifest, application icons, and service-worker functionality for supported offline features. Play on compatible mobile devices and desktop browsers without needing a traditional app-store installation.

TECHNOLOGY
The project uses HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with WebRTC for voice communication, Firebase-related functionality for online features, and Progressive Web App technologies.

SOURCE CODE
The project source code is available on GitHub for inspection and development:
https://github.com/RochTools/the-mill-game

PLAY ONLINE
https://rochtools.github.io/the-mill-game/

The Mill Game brings classic board-game strategy and modern online interaction together in one accessible web application. Think ahead, form your mills, and win the match.
